storyTitle: Verify Statement Credit Accumulation & Goal Progress
oneSentenceStory: Daniel reviews his 7,300 LBG coin balance and tracks progress toward his holiday spending goal with direct statement credit allocation.
customerSituation: Daniel visits the rewards overview to check accumulated coins and monitor progress on his holiday spending savings goal.
storyTension: Ensuring transparent, predictable value without confusing gamification or irrelevant voucher promotions.
customerResolution: Clear display of coin balance, guaranteed cash-equivalent conversion rates, and direct holiday savings goal milestones.
primaryOutcome: Effortless verification of payment-linked reward accumulation and clear insight into statement credit progress.
prohibitedDetours: Voucher or experience promotions not aligned with payment utility
